The '''Necropolitan language''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] inhabitants of [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that served as a [[Burial/Legends|burial]] place for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The planet's name iself meant "[[City/Legends|City]] of the [[Death/Legends|Dead]]." The Necropolitan language possessed [[Necropolitan symbols|its own]] [[Writing/Legends|writing system]], which could be seen on the numerous gravestones scattered across the tombworld's landscape, sometimes with a translation in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]], the most common language of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While [[Gender/Legends|he]] did not know the Necropolitan language, the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] could still guess the meaning of some gravestones' inscriptions.
